notes: Curve-specific redistribution rights and provenance remain unresolved. Current SDSS policy declares public-release data public domain, separately from its image-only CC-BY policy; applicability to these response curves, particularly primed filter-only entries, is not established. The legacy SDSS-I/II credits page still displays commercial-use restrictions for archive data; do not silently resolve that historical/current policy distinction as a curve licence. The full acknowledgement above is reproduced from the expressly requested SDSS-I/II acknowledgement. Current collaboration page directs users of previous survey phases to their phase-specific acknowledgements. The description and the Gunn et al. (1998) and Doi et al. (2010) references come from the SDSS camera page (https://www.sdss4.org/instruments/camera/), which links both papers on ADS; the primed filter-only curves are described from SVO's band records. Band metadata remain SVO's, and no assignment of primed versus unprimed profiles beyond SVO's is made. The acknowledgement is the SDSS-I/II non-commercial wording from https://classic.sdss.org/collaboration/credits.php; that page also says: 'Please also refer to the appropriate SDSS technical publications.'

SDSS imaging camera and filter throughput curves

description: Sloan Digital Sky Survey u, g, r, i, z passbands. The full-transmission curves (u, g, r, i, z) are for the SDSS imaging camera, which collects photometric imaging data with an array of 30 2048 x 2048 CCDs in six columns of five, the r, i, u, z and g filters each covering one row, operated in drift-scan mode (Gunn et al. 1998). SDSS describes its June 2001 throughput tables as defining the survey's photometric system, including extinction through an airmass of 1.3 at Apache Point Observatory, and notes that Doi et al. (2010) published more recent estimates, finding that the u band in particular has changed over time. The uprime_filter to zprime_filter curves are filter-only transmissions of the primed u'g'r'i'z' filters, which SVO describes as at the USNO 40-in.
short_description: SDSS ugriz camera passbands plus primed u'g'r'i'z' filter-only curves
